question: Does correct framing establish exactly-once application execution, a fleet loss rate or a throughput improvement?

criteria.instruction: No. This sample defines framing and selected decoder failures, not sender retry/idempotency or downstream side effects. Prior delivered messages cannot be recalled after later failure. No traffic denominator or performance experiment exists.
Use stream limits and review/journal to distinguish decoder correctness from business delivery and performance evidence.
Decline exactly-once guarantees, fleet message-loss percentages and measured throughput gains. Do not infer network loss from parser loss.
